claims.title: Choose a complete-memory control interface: private tape or fresh delayed quantum flags

quoted_fields.interface: Tape privacy against ALL accessible memory/reference/public seed plus one fixed protected frame-controlled process; or freshly prepared flags, common core independent of direct flag access/control signals, trusted frames/late readout, key retirement and same-role complete test instrument. DFS/clean-event theorem additionally supplies its exact algebra/block/norm/zero-event hypotheses.
quoted_fields.failure: Approximate privacy does not create exact ideal fault labels. Data-mediated frame inference is allowed; separate key exposure is not. Equal current output or uniform key counts do not certify full memory. Role-hiding needs matched bath marginals/external signals. No easy matched corrections for arbitraryG or freeT resource. Extractor budget/seed/numerical claims remain source reports; ordinary trusted private RNG can be simpler.

claims.title: Replace perfect flag isolation by a complete-call correctable access contract

quoted_fields.interface: Actual declared four-spin encoding and common completed core confined to one known spin, or the narrower unknown-site completed Kraus span; trusted whole syndrome/recovery, logical frames/late private readout/retirement and matched complete test.
quoted_fields.failure: Instantaneous one-site contact is insufficient. Unknown-site detection is not deterministic correction or free payload retry; permitted errors may reject every attempt. Recovery preserves flags but does not improve arbitrary bad data.15-entangling-operation subtotal is an ideal source compilation report with other physical costs open.

claims.title: Compose mobile correctable access and price reliable recovery checkpoints

quoted_fields.interface: A qualified correctable code/error set and reliable complete recovery between access regions; or code-preserving reference, bounded detectable coupling on each interval and trusted deterministic syndrome recovery. Adaptive reports may remain; actual private keys are retired. Ledger-only operation must preserve the hypothesis under its actual Pauli frame.
quoted_fields.failure: A logical PVP term survives indefinitely many checkpoints. Initial-code PVP=0 alone does not prove a generic syndrome-only ledger implementation. Detailed eight-spin code, optimality/netlists/33-interaction count, numerical residuals and code/runtime archives are unacquired source reports. Faulty syndrome extraction may propagate an undetected hook; more checks are not free.
